subject.title: feat(onboarding): offer detected Claude Code/Codex/Hermes memory imports across CLI, macOS, and Linux onboarding

question: Should this onboarding feature wait for the observed migration-backup hang to be fixed or bounded, or may it land with that first-run availability risk explicitly accepted?
rationale: The implementation reuses a shipped engine, but its submitted Linux E2E encountered an indefinite apply stall in the exact new onboarding path; accepting that exposure is a maintainer-owned merge-risk decision.

options.title: Bound the flow before merge
options.body: Fix or safely bound the backup/apply stall, add visible recovery, and provide completed Linux and native macOS onboarding proof before landing.

options.title: Accept the known stall risk
options.body: Land the feature while explicitly accepting that some first-run imports may remain stuck until the separately tracked backup problem is fixed.

recommendation.title: Bound the flow before merge
recommendation.body: Fix or safely bound the backup/apply stall, add visible recovery, and provide completed Linux and native macOS onboarding proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest current-main history across onboarding and Control UI and is best positioned to own the cross-platform merge-risk choice.
